definitions.explanation: A type of housing where multiple unrelated people live together, sharing common spaces like the kitchen, living room, and bathroom while having private bedrooms.

examples.japanese: シェアハウス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んで→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I live in a share house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧シェアハウス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}して→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a share house in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: シェアハウス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can interact with foreigners at a share house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧シェアハウス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}った→移る：01232_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: I moved to a share house to keep rent down.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: Japanese-English coinage combining "share" + "house." In English, similar concepts are called "shared housing," "house share," or "co-living space."

TYPES:
・⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧シェアハウス - women-only share house
・⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧シェアハウス - international exchange share house
・⟦コンセプト→コンセプト：10859_konseputo⟧シェアハウス - concept/themed share house

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・シェアハウス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (to live in a share house)
・シェアハウス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住人|じゅうにん}→住人：11611_juunin⟧ (share house residents)
・シェアハウス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{共用|きょうよう}→共用：21529_kyouyou⟧⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧ (common areas)
・シェアハウス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入居|にゅうきょ}→入居：08630_nyuukyo⟧⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧ (share house application screening)

CULTURAL NOTE: Share houses gained popularity in Japan in the 2000s-2010s, especially among young people in urban areas. TV shows like 「テラスハウス」 helped popularize the concept. They offer a middle ground between living alone and traditional boarding houses (⟦{下宿|げしゅく}→下宿：01399_geshuku⟧).

DIFFERENCE FROM OTHER HOUSING:
・⟦{下宿|げしゅく}→下宿：01399_geshuku⟧ - boarding house (older concept, often with meals provided)
・⟦ルームシェア→ルームシェア：09731_ruumushea⟧ - room sharing (sharing an apartment with roommates)
・⟦ゲストハウス→ゲストハウス：noentry⟧ - guest house (often more short-term)
